source: Read-only forwarded ADB recovery and user report

user_report.display: Partial Apple animation visible briefly during boot

kernel_pc_symbolication.mapping_basis: Same linked kernel, static VM addresses preserved by mkpayload and shim loader; no cache slide used.
kernel_pc_symbolication.interpretation: Timer-interrupted kernel allocation path near function entry; a compare instruction sample is not evidence of an allocator fault or a stuck allocator.

limitations: Header heartbeat81 precedes visible user heartbeat84; does not record final stall state.
IRQ entered==handler_done and phase2 only characterize saved snapshot before common IRQ epilogue.
No second I89 screen observation was supplied, so IRQ versus heartbeat progress at the visible stop cannot yet be classified.
Missing IOKit/exec/swap console lines do not override nonzero copy counters.
exec DumpPanic is a daemon launch, not by itself a kernel panic report.
User rapportd line is not present in committed console snapshot and does not identify the instruction at stall.
